Blueface reveals he’s currently making over $136K per week from streaming 🤑

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper and media personality from Los Angeles, California. Before pursuing a music career, he played high school and college football as a quarterback.

He initially began rapping in 2017 and rose to widespread internet fame in late 2018 following the release of his music video for “Respect My Cryppin’”. He quickly became a viral sensation due to his distinctive, off-beat delivery style and high-energy persona. His commercial breakout occurred in 2019 with the success of his hit single “Thotiana,” which reached the top ten of the Billboard Hot 100 after receiving popular remixes featuring artists like Cardi B and YG.

Beyond his music career, Blueface has participated in celebrity boxing matches and maintained a high-profile presence on social media and reality television.
